statement_html:
We have a rectangle whose perimeter is 206 mm. Given that the length is 23 mm longer than the width, find out the length and the width (in mm).

solution_html:
Let \(x\) the length, \(y\) the width. Then we have the following system.
\(\left\lbrace \begin{array}{ccccc} 2x &+& 2y &=& 206\\\ x &-& y &=& 23\end{array}\right .\)
And the solution of this system is \(x = 63\), \(y = 40\).
